summary: Frontend-only smoke of iteration 4 changes (option-list editor, inline dropdowns, JJ.MM.AAAA banner dates, farm list title). All 7 requested feature checks PASS. Regression on 6-tab nav + persistence via async-storage/IndexedDB verified after full reload.
action_items: [Nit] /app/frontend/src/store/AppStore.tsx uses type `ArchivedPatch` at line 331 without importing it (currently relies on TS being non-strict / bundler ignoring). Import it from ./types for cleanliness.

[Nit] Header subtitle in agent screen renders `${element} · ${specialization}` — visible update after picking a new element in the dropdown was harder to detect because the same text is also in the ÉLÉMENT control. Not a bug, just noting.
critical_code_review_comments: All new components (Select, MultiSelect, DateField, EditableList) use testID props → excellent test coverage surface.
Persistence path OK: setOptionList → optionLists in AppState → migrate() spreads base.optionLists then saved.optionLists so new keys stay backward compatible.
BuildSheet dropdowns are inside a BottomSheet ScrollView; option lists render inline (no nested modal) — works, but on small viewports the control may need manual scroll to reach save-build-button.
seed_data_creation: Added an editable option-list entry 'TestElem' via the UI (Réglages → Données du jeu → Éléments → AJOUTER). Also saved a new agent build with Set 4pc = Woodpecker Electro on Qingyi. Data lives in async-storage (IndexedDB); can be cleared by the main agent if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: URL: https://mobile-dev-blueprint.preview.emergentagent.com. Tabs are text-based (Accueil/Farm/Projection/Historique/ZZZdex/Réglages) — no testID on tab bar items, use page.get_by_text('X', exact=True). Agent tiles use testID `agent-tile-<id>` (e.g. agent-tile-qingyi). Build sheet dropdowns are inside a scrollable BottomSheet; when Playwright reports 'Element is outside viewport' use `locator.dispatch_event('click')` instead of `page.click()` — it fires the same onClick handler the RN Pressable listens to on web. IndexedDB persists across page.reload().
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Detailed feature verification: (1) agent-release + agent-lastbanner values read as '04.09.2024' for Qingyi ✅. (2) Typing '15062025' → reformats live to '15.06.2025' and persists after reload ✅. (3) Zero occurrences of 'Données de farm' on general tab (card removed) ✅. (4) select-element and select-spec are inline accordion dropdowns; options render as `${testID}-opt-<value>` ✅. (5) Build sheet: build-set4/set2/stat4/stat5/stat6 single-select all functional; build-substats multi-select toggles ATK% and control text becomes 'Crit RATE, Crit ATK, ATK%' ✅. save-build-button creates a new 'Nouveau build' (PERSO) card showing chosen Set 4pc = Woodpecker Electro and sous-stats ✅. (6) 5 option-list cards present (optlist-elements/specializations/discSets/mainStats/subStats). optlist-elements-add appends blank input; typing 'TestElem' into it makes it appear as select-element-opt-TestElem back on the agent page ✅. After page.reload() TestElem still present and date edit still 15.06.2025 → IndexedDB persistence confirmed ✅. (7) Farm tab LISTE DE FARM shows 'État des stocks' title + subtitle 'Ce qu'il te reste à farmer, par priorité...' above material rows ✅. (8) 6 tab bar items visible ✅.
